segment_contamination_dimensions: Portable, temporary, and lightweight shelter buyers (Portable Shelters, Portable Garage, Folding Garage, Dome Shelters) — these buyers seek relocatable or non-engineered structures, incompatible with the permanent, custom-engineered PEB buyer persona.

Specialist single-use shed buyers with distinct procurement channels (Poultry Sheds, Cattle Sheds, Telecom Shelters, Military Shelters) — buyer personas, use contexts, and procurement processes are fundamentally different from industrial/warehouse PEB buyers.

Generic prefabricated shed buyers (Prefabricated Shed, Prefabricated Shelters, Metal Sheds, Metal Shelters, Tin Shed) — these buyers seek off-the-shelf or low-specification structures, not the custom-engineered, IS 800-governed PEB fabrication service targeted here.

Specific-application roofing shed buyers (Auditorium Roofing Shed, Badminton Court Roofing Shed, Swimming Pool Shed, Swimming Pool Tensile Cover) — these are narrow single-application buyers distinct from the industrial/warehouse PEB primary segment.
